longDescription: Ported from the open-source project ai-berkshire (MIT): 15 value-investing research skills built on the methodologies of Buffett, Munger, Duan Yongping and Li Lu — covering deep research (company deep dives, management assessment, private companies), earnings analysis (four-masters team reading), industry screening (funnel screening, bottleneck hunter, era alpha), portfolio management (thesis tracker, drift detection) and thinking tools (Duan Yongping Q&A, WeChat article writing). Ships with validation scripts such as financial_rigor; data fetching prefers locally installed official data plugins. For learning and research only; not investment advice.
tryPrompts: Do a deep investment research on Kweichow Moutai for me
Run the pre-purchase checklist on Tencent
Compare my old and new investment theses for drift

bottleneck-hunter.description: Scan bottleneck links in mega-trend supply chains for listed-company opportunities

dyp-ask.description: Answer business, investing and culture questions in Duan Yongping's mindset

earnings-team.description: Four-masters earnings reading, rewritten into a publishable WeChat article

era-alpha.description: Identify alpha companies with pricing power and moats in today's core growth industries

income-investment.description: Assess dividend sustainability and opportunistic dividend value

industry-funnel.description: Layer-by-layer market screening down to 3 value-investing picks

investment-checklist.description: Item-by-item value-investing pre-purchase checklist for one or more companies

investment-research.description: Comprehensive four-masters research on a single company with a final report

investment-team.description: Parallel analysis of one company by business model, valuation, industry and risk roles

management-deep-dive.description: Assess CEO and core management circle of competence, integrity and capital allocation record

private-company-research.description: Parallel fragment collection and cross-validated valuation for private companies

quality-screen.description: Quickly eliminate unqualified targets with 7 first-class company indicators

thesis-drift.description: Compare old and new theses to detect substantive drift in investment logic

thesis-tracker.description: Disciplined post-purchase review of valuation anchors, key assumptions and catalysts

wechat-article.description: Author-editor-reader workflow producing a publishable WeChat deep article
